event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-off, broad distribution, semis cracked.
Higher-for-longer confirmed: import prices +1.1% vs 0.7% fc and a December hike fully priced drove duration-sensitive selling, while a 75/426 advance/decline and 0.18 up/down volume says this was liquidation, not rotation. Nvidia earnings risk plus CRM -9.45% and NOW -6.51% ahead of AI verification killed software and mega-cap appetite.

INDICES — VIX 25.5, up (VIXY +7.41%); QQQ is below its 200-DMA, a CTA sell trigger.
SOXX +0.17%, QQQ -0.73%, SPY -1.01%, IJH -1.31%, IJR -1.37%, IWM -1.43%, RSP -1.45%, DIA -1.62%. Large > small by 0.64pp — the wrong way; today's leadership was mega-cap, not breadth. Notable cross-asset: VIXY +7.41% and TLT +0.21% — bonds bid on growth fear, not on cuts.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY 1.5x and QQQ roughly 1x with price down: distribution in SPY, low-conviction bleed in QQQ. Semis drew attention (SOXX 1.5x) while silver and gold were ignored (SLV 0.9x, GLD 0.8x). Financials 1.6x down and XLF -1.91% is the cleanest distribution signal of the day. Breadth diverges hard: only 15% of S&P names up, 58% above 50-DMA, 4 new highs vs 35 lows — participation disconfirms any stabilization.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy -0.52%, XLI Industrials -0.55%, XLY Discretionary -0.89%, XLK Technology -0.91%, XLB Materials -1.22%, XLP Staples -1.23%, XLV Healthcare -1.41%, XLC Comms -1.46%, XLRE Real Estate -1.49%, XLU Utilities -1.59%, XLF Financials -1.91%.
GDX +0.79% led, TAN -5.17% and IGV -3.29% lagged. Flows: XLK +$1,231mm (100th pctile) and XLI +$574mm (86p) in; XLE -$246mm (27p) and XLF -$209mm (44p) out — tech inflows into a -0.91% tape contradict price, so that's dip-buying, not confirmation. Money is leaving financials and energy; it's hiding in tech and industrials. Rotation state: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR 1.20 (protection demand) vs SPY 0.70 and IWM 0.53 (complacent); QQQ ATM IV 36.9% vs SPY 23.4%. Skew positive everywhere (SPY +13.8%) — puts are being bought. VIX 25.5 vs 20-day 20.0 and VIXEQ 48.6 vs VIX 25.5 = very wide single-stock dispersion, a stock-picker's tape, not correlated macro.

CROSS-ASSET — Silver +0.59% while gold -0.13% and SLV down -18.19% over 20d: industrial demand holding, monetary hedge unwinding. Oil +0.15% with XLE -0.52% and TAN -5.17% shows energy pricing isn't transmitting to equities — cost pressure, not earnings. Next FOMC Dec 9: Polymarket 25bp hike 94% YES (+6pp in 5d), 50bp+ just 4%.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 55, Neutral. CRM -9.45%, INTU -7.17%, NOW -6.51% on software de-rating; FDN 5.0x at -1.96% and AIQ 2.1x at -1.72% = distribution. Worst 20d: XLK -11.96%; best: XLP +4.23%. Watch IGV -3.29% at 1.8x volume, FDN 5.0x on a down day, and IWM PCR 0.53 — too calm into a 200-DMA-adjacent tape.
